description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Web and domain checks] SPF, DKIM and DMARC check. Check a domain's email authentication and spoofing risk from public DNS: MX and mail provider, SPF (record, all-qualifier, DNS lookup count vs the 10 limit), DMARC policy/pct/rua, DKIM at 30 common selectors, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI. Returns grade, spoofable flag and fixes. ~1-3 s.

domain.description: Domain that sends the email, e.g. example.com (a URL or an address like jane@example.com also works)

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

name: email_auth

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.
